Generated when a user changes policy precedence in the Falcon console. Note that when you change policy precedence, you will see two or more
update_precedence events. For example, if you move a policy from precedence 4 to precedence 2, you will see events that reflect the following:
4 became 2
2 became 3
3 became 4
